scripts.dev: npm run build:embed && concurrently -n api,admin -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @support-hub/api" "npm run dev -w @support-hub/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run build -w @support-hub/loader && npm run build -w @support-hub/widget && npm run build -w @support-hub/api && npm run build -w @support-hub/worker && npm run build -w @support-hub/admin
scripts.check: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run build -w @support-hub/api && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:quality
scripts.test: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:quality
scripts.check:quality: tsc --noEmit --pretty false --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --strict --skipLibCheck --noUncheckedIndexedAccess scripts/lib/nora-quality.mts scripts/inspect-nora-quality.mts tests/nora-quality.test.mts
scripts.demo: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=apps/api/.env --env-file-if-exists=apps/api/.env.local --import tsx scripts/demo.mts
scripts.demo:visual: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,host "npm run start -w @support-hub/api" "npm run start -w @support-hub/demo-host"
scripts.build:embed: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run build -w @support-hub/loader && npm run build -w @support-hub/widget
scripts.test:db: npm run build -w @support-hub/contracts && npm run test:db -w @support-hub/api
scripts.dev:widget: npm run build:embed && npm run build -w @support-hub/api && npm run build -w @support-hub/worker && NODE_ENV=development HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3100 TRUST_PROXY_HOPS=0 concurrently -k -n api,worker "node --env-file=apps/api/.env --env-file=apps/api/.env.local apps/api/dist/server.js" "node --env-file=apps/api/.env --env-file=apps/api/.env.local apps/worker/dist/index.js"
scripts.test:chat: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.chat.config.ts
